content.value: According to a survey, the probability that a family owns a car if its monthly (10) household income is greater than BDT 100,000 is 0.80. Of the household surveyed, 58% had incomes over BDT 100,000 and 50% had a car. A family is randomly selected; find out the probability that the family has a car and an income over BDT 100,000 monthly.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
